description: Register, inspect or remove the Dropscan push webhook, so new mail arrives without waiting for a sync. action: 'register' (default) points Dropscan at this project's dropscan-sync endpoint for the events mailing_received + mailing_scanned (or the `events` you pass) and replaces any rule we registered before; 'list' shows the rules currently registered on the Dropscan account; 'delete' removes ours (optionally a specific rule_id). Registering writes a real rule into the Dropscan account. An hourly scheduled sync runs underneath regardless, so a dropped event is caught within the hour.

events.description: Dropscan events to subscribe to (default mailing_received and mailing_scanned)

name: manage_dropscan_webhook
